# League of California Cities

> > The League of California Cities provides legal resources, continuing education, and advocacy support for municipal attorneys across California.

This site serves city attorneys and municipal legal professionals with MCLE-accredited training through the City Attorneys Spring Conference, comprehensive legal libraries, amicus brief filings, and professional development resources. The League represents California cities in legal matters and provides specialized support through its City Attorneys' Department.

## Key Topics

- Municipal law
- City attorneys
- Continuing Legal Education (CLE)
- MCLE credit
- City Attorneys Spring Conference
- Amicus briefs
- Employment law
- Legal advocacy
- Court filings
- California Supreme Court cases
- City attorney library
- Legal opinions
- Conference papers
- Legal training programs

## Continuing Legal Education & Training

- [Continuing Legal Education](https://www.cacities.org/CLE): CLE programs & MCLE credit for city attorneys via Spring Conference
- [City Attorneys' Continuing Legal Education](https://www.cacities.org/Member-Engagement/Professional-Departments/City-Attorneys/Continuing-Legal-Education): CLE training & MCLE credits for City Attorneys' Department members

## Legal Resources & Reference

- [City Attorneys' Library](https://www.cacities.org/Member-Engagement/Professional-Departments/City-Attorneys/Library): City Attorneys' document library with briefs, papers & legal opinions
- [Recent Filings](https://www.cacities.org/recentfilings): Recent amicus briefs & court filings in CA municipal law cases
